summary: Pursuant to section 173(2) of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 and the Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 3, the Ombudsman is required to submit an annual report on the activities of her office directly to City Council.
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the Ombudsman Toronto 2017 Annual Report for information.

motions.desc: Majority required - CC39.4 - Adopt the item
